arguments.description: 16x16 pixel-art UI status icon for the Ready (task completed successfully) state of a queue. One bold, centered check mark with clearly asymmetrical arms: a short left arm meeting a much longer right arm that rises toward the upper right. Chunky 2-pixel-wide strokes, filled in a cool sky blue close to #70b9ed with one lighter blue highlight tone, crisp hard pixel edges, no anti-aliased blur, no stray pixels. Must read clearly at 1x and at 3x nearest-neighbor scale on a dark navy panel (#172336). Transparent background, no text, no circle or badge plate behind the mark, no drop shadow, single static image.

criteria.scope: Revised representative Ready status sample (queue.ready, second generation) under the refreshed contract: owner-required check mark with asymmetrical arms; later consumer destination assets/ready-confirmed.png. Only this candidate's own mechanical, meaning, check-mark, readability and accent-relationship checks are required at this stage, plus two scoped specialist sample criteria. Family distinction (Working/Retry/Paused vs Ready), the style-approval decision, placement at assets/ready-confirmed.png and renderer integration of statusCell/compactStatus are deferred later-stage obligations recorded with stage and prerequisites in rev2/request-review.json and PLAR, not rejection rules for this sample.

contract.intent: One static 16x16 Ready status image for later delivery to the consumer path assets/ready-confirmed.png. Owner requirements: check mark with asymmetrical arms conveying successful completion, transparent background, cool blue accent, no fixed palette (partial alpha permitted). Specialist sample choices, revisable at style review: short left arm with longer right arm, chunky ~2px strokes, sky blue near #70b9ed with one lighter highlight, no backing plate or shadow.

choices.choice: Ready remains the representative family sample.
choices.reason: Static, single frame, no dependency on other statuses.

choices.choice: Short left arm meeting a longer right arm rising to the upper right.
choices.reason: Conventional check-mark orientation that satisfies the owner's asymmetrical-arms requirement; the criterion does not require this orientation, so a mirrored asymmetric mark is not rejected.

choices.choice: Single centered check mark, chunky ~2px strokes, no backing circle/badge plate, no drop shadow.
choices.reason: Chunky strokes survive 1x at 16x16 while leaving room for a visibly unequal arm length; no plate keeps transparency simple and leaves room for later family marks. Revisable at style review; not a rejection rule.

choices.choice: Cool sky blue close to #70b9ed plus one lighter highlight tone; no fixed palette.
choices.authority: specialist choice implementing owner 'cool blue accent' direction
choices.reason: Relates to the observed Start fill without making the hex a rejection rule; a lighter tone keeps contrast on #172336.

choices.choice: create_image_pro_flash, width 16, height 16, no_background true, seed omitted.
choices.authority: specialist choice within the discovered schema
choices.reason: Only advertised generation tool; native 16x16 avoids downscaling (fixture default is 64x64, so explicit); no_background matches transparency; no seed specified or needed.

choices.authority: derived from brief (transparent, no fixed palette)
choices.reason: Avoids manufacturing a binary-alpha or fixed-palette rule.

choices.reason: Support later owner non-colour and coherence obligations while judging only this sample; caller may demote or drop them.

choices.reason: Same visual role; the runtime assigns the generation's task/output/job IDs, which are reported from the prepare result.
